chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ahmad from Aban from Abu Maryam from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding an aunt (paternal) and an aunt (maternal), he said: 'One-third and two-thirds,' meaning for the paternal aunt two-thirds and for the maternal aunt one-third.
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a paternal aunt versus a maternal aunt in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific inheritance shares for paternal and maternal aunts, assigning two-thirds to the paternal aunt and one-third to the maternal aunt. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the distinct roles of paternal and maternal kinship lines in estate distribution, often discussed in the context of *Fara'id* (fixed shares) where these aunts may inherit as residual heirs or fixed-share recipients depending on the presence of other heirs.
